title: Daily Deposit Bonus — Modern fantasy
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / character and art-direction revision.
Edit the supplied 1983 x 793 static Daily Deposit Bonus campaign banner for Jito. The user feels the character and setting are too stereotypically Indian. Replace that cultural royal archetype with a distinct MODERN FANTASY character and neutral abstract setting.
Keep the exact composition, full-bleed wide aspect ratio, camera, left-side lettering, subtitle, chest, coin branding, color balance and high-quality cinematic 3D illustration.
Character: replace the existing long-haired queen with a clearly different adult woman around 30, a confident contemporary fantasy treasure curator. Short sleek dark bob haircut, side part, clean contemporary styling, subtle natural makeup, relaxed confident expression looking toward the viewer. She wears a beautifully tailored burgundy high-neck jacket with broad clean fabric panels, restrained champagne-gold piping and a small simple cuff. Refined but not traditional royal clothing, no dress drapes, no armor, no military insignia. Maintain the seated/leaning pose beside the open treasure chest, one hand resting naturally on its rim and the other presenting the branded coin; anatomically natural hands. Keep her foreground prominence and size. Character should feel like an original modern game protagonist, not an ethnic or national costume archetype.
Remove all forehead jewels/bindi, nose rings, tiara, dangling traditional earrings, ornate necklaces, bangles and sari-like styling. No cultural or religious iconography. Do not create another similar long-haired jeweled queen.
Background: replace palace pillars and architecture with soft-focus abstract teal light and warm champagne bokeh. Replace the mandala/rune-filled halo with two or three elegant clean concentric teal light rings, a sparse neutral glimmer; no mandala, runes, sacred symbols, flower geometry or astrological glyphs. Keep the clean rings sharp, distant background blurred.
Preserve the open burgundy lacquer and champagne-gold treasure chest, its original Jito emblem, the main floating gold coins and small ruby accents. The emblem is a brand logo and must remain. Preserve the readable, simplified polished material style and foreground depth. Burgundy #681C32, champagne gold #E8C77D, teal #46B8A5.
TEXT MUST STAY EXACTLY as in the image, with same positions, size, font, extrusion and line breaks:
"EVERY DAY"
"DAILY DEPOSIT"
"BONUS"
"A new day. A new bonus."
Keep all text sharp, unobscured and unchanged. BONUS remains the largest word. NO buttons, no CTA, no extra words, no numbers or currencies, no watermark. Do not redraw or move the typography. Only revise the character/costume and culturally coded background to the modern fantasy direction described. Finished static artwork, not a website mockup.
